runes.name: Health Scaling
runes.desc: +10-180 Health (based on level)

notes: Health Scaling is taken to grow evenly from level 1 to level 18.

runes.name: Attack Speed
runes.desc: +10% Attack Speed

runes.name: Ability Haste
runes.desc: +8 Ability Haste

runes.name: Adaptive Force
runes.desc: +9 Adaptive Force

runes.name: Move Speed
runes.desc: +2.5% Move Speed

runes.name: Health
runes.desc: +65 Health

runes.name: Tenacity and Slow Resist
runes.desc: +15% Tenacity and Slow Resist

notes: Tenacity and slow resist do not change damage.

runes.name: Press the Attack
runes.desc: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive basic attacks deals 40 - 160 bonus adaptive damage (based on level) and amplifies your damage dealt by 8% until you leave combat with champions.

notes: Press the Attack counts basic attacks only; an empowered attack the champion's model writes as an ability does not count toward the three.
Its damage grows evenly with level. It lands once a fight; the damage amplification starts after it and lasts the rest of the combo, as you stay in combat.

controls.label: Press the Attack

runes.name: Lethal Tempo
runes.desc: Attacking an enemy champion grants you [6% Melee || 4% Ranged] Attack Speed for 6 seconds, up to 6. At max stacks, deal [9 - 30 Melee || 6 - 24 Ranged] bonus adaptive damage On-Attack, increased by 1% per 1% Bonus Attack Speed.

notes: Each basic attack adds a stack and its attack speed; the attack that reaches full stacks deals the bonus damage too. The stacks fall off when an attack comes more than their duration after the last.
Ranged numbers follow the game's own calculations (4.8% attack speed per stack, 6 - 20 damage), which differ from the 4% and 6 - 24 in the rune's description.

controls.label: Lethal Tempo stacks when the combo starts

runes.name: Presence of Mind
runes.desc:
Damaging an enemy champion restores 6-50 (80% for ranged) mana or 6 energy.

Takedowns restore 15% of your maximum mana or energy. 

Cooldown for damage restoration: 8s

notes: Presence of Mind restores mana or energy; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Conqueror
runes.desc:
Basic attacks or spells that deal damage to an enemy champion grant 2 stacks of Conqueror for 5s, gaining 1.8-4 Adaptive Force per stack. Stacks up to 12 times. Ranged champions gain only 1 stack per basic attack.

When fully stacked, heal for 8% of the damage you deal to champions (5% for ranged champions).

notes: Conqueror gains its stacks through the combo, and its Adaptive Force follows them. Sustained damage counts full stacks. Stacks are taken not to fall off mid-fight.
Adaptive Force per stack grows evenly with level; a point is worth 0.6 Attack Damage or 1 Ability Power. The healing at full stacks is not counted.

controls.label: Conqueror stacks when the combo starts

runes.name: Coup de Grace
runes.desc: Deal 8% more damage to champions who have less than 40% health.

runes.name: Cut Down
runes.desc: Deal 8% more damage to champions who have more than 60% health.

runes.name: Fleet Footwork
runes.desc:
Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack is Energized

Energized attacks heal you for 15 - 160 (+0.1 Bonus AD, +0.05 AP) and grant 20% Move Speed for 1s.

For Ranged Champions, Healing is 60% effective and Move Speed is 75% effective. All healing is 15% effective against Minions.

notes: Fleet Footwork heals and gives move speed; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Relentless Hunter
runes.desc: Gain 8 Move Speed out of combat per Bounty Hunter stack. Bounty Hunter stacks are earned the first time you get a takedown on each enemy champion.

notes: Relentless Hunter gives move speed out of combat; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Ultimate Hunter
runes.desc: Your ultimate gains 6 Ability Haste, plus an additional 5 Ability Haste per Bounty Hunter stack. Bounty Hunter stacks are earned the first time you get a takedown on each enemy champion.

notes: Ultimate Hunter only shortens the cooldown of your ultimate shown; it does not change the combo.

controls.label: Bounty Hunter stacks: enemy champions you have taken down

runes.name: Electrocute
runes.desc:
Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3s deals bonus adaptive damage.

Damage: 70 - 240 (+0.1 bonus AD, +0.05 AP) damage.
Cooldown: 20s

'We called them the Thunderlords, for to speak of their lightning was to invite disaster.'

notes: Electrocute counts each basic attack and each ability cast that deals damage as one hit, and strikes after the third within its window. Hits made while it cools down do not count.

controls.label: Electrocute

runes.name: Cheap Shot
runes.desc:
Damaging champions with impaired movement or actions deals 10 - 45 bonus true damage (based on level).

Cooldown: 4s
Activates on damage occurring after the impairment.

notes: Which abilities impair is not known to the engine: with its setting on, Cheap Shot fires on any damage, on its cooldown, for the whole combo. Leave it off and count it by hand when only part of the combo lands on an impaired target.

controls.label: The target is slowed, stunned or otherwise impaired during the combo
Cheap Shot

runes.name: Dark Harvest
runes.desc:
Damaging a Champion below 50% health deals adaptive damage and harvests their soul, permanently increasing Dark Harvest's damage by 11.

Dark Harvest damage: 30 (+11 damage per soul) (+0.1 bonus AD) (+0.05 AP)
Cooldown: 35s (resets to 1.0s on takedown)

notes: Dark Harvest strikes on the first damage that leaves the target below its health threshold, and the soul it takes counts from its next strike on. Its cooldown reset on takedowns does not matter against one target.

controls.label: Souls harvested so far this game
Dark Harvest

runes.name: Treasure Hunter
runes.desc:
Gain an additional 50 gold the next time you collect a Bounty Hunter stack. Increase the gold gained by 20 gold for each Bounty Hunter stack, up to 130 gold.

Bounty Hunter stacks are earned the first time you get a takedown on each enemy champion.

notes: Treasure Hunter gives gold; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Sixth Sense
runes.desc:
Automatically sense a nearby untracked and unseen ward, tracking it for the team. 

Level 11: Also reveal the ward for 10s.

This effect has a 250 second Cooldown.

notes: Sixth Sense finds wards; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Taste of Blood
runes.desc:
Heal when you damage an enemy champion.

Healing: 16-40 (+0.1 bonus AD, +0.05 AP) health (based on level)

Cooldown: 20s

notes: Taste of Blood heals; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Grisly Mementos
runes.desc:
Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns, up to 18 total.

Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected. In game modes where vision Trinkets do not exist, instead gain 3 Summoner Spell Haste.

notes: Grisly Mementos gives trinket or summoner spell haste; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Deep Ward
runes.desc:
Your wards in the enemy jungle are Deep. Deep wards gain +1 extra Health and +[30 - 45]s increased duration (+[45 - 150]s for Trinket stealth wards).

Level 9: Wards in the river are also Deep.

notes: Deep Ward makes wards last longer; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Sudden Impact
runes.desc:
Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal a bonus 20 - 80 True Damage based on level to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth for 4s.

Cooldown: 10s

notes: Which abilities dash or blink is not known to the engine: with its setting on, Sudden Impact fires on the first damage of the combo within its window. Dashes later in the combo are not tracked; count those by hand.

controls.label: The combo opens with a dash, leap, blink or leaving stealth
Sudden Impact

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.desc:
Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels:
Level 5: +5 Ability Haste 
Level 8: +5 Ability Haste 
Level 11: On Champion takedown, reduce the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%.

notes: The cooldown refund on takedowns from level 11 is not counted.

runes.name: Summon Aery
runes.desc:
Damaging enemy champions with basic attacks or abilities sends Aery to them, dealing 10 - 50 based on level (+0.05 AP) (+0.1 bonus AD).

Empowering or protecting allies with abilities sends Aery to them, shielding them for 20 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP) (+0.1 bonus AD).

Aery cannot be sent out again until she returns to you.

notes: Aery is sent by the first attack or damaging ability of the combo, and again by the first one after she is back. Her round trip is a setting: about a second in melee range and two at range by default.
Her shield on allies is not counted.

controls.label: Seconds Aery takes to come back to you
Aery

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.desc:
Your Ultimate has 12% increased damage, healing, and shielding. 
(AoE damage is reduced to a 8% increase)

Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown by 7%.

notes: Counts the damage of your ultimate's cast; damage it deals later through attacks or marks is not amplified. Its bonus is the single-target one unless "Your ultimate hits an area" is set.
The cooldown refund on takedowns is not counted.

controls.label: Your ultimate hits an area (smaller bonus)

runes.name: Manaflow Band
runes.desc:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 25, up to 250 mana.

After reaching 250 bonus mana, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.

Cooldown: 15 seconds

notes: Its bonus mana counts toward damage that scales with mana, at the full 250 by default; mana gained during the combo and the mana it restores are not counted.

controls.label: Times Manaflow Band has grown your mana

runes.name: Arcane Comet
runes.desc:
Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing increased damage based on distance.

Adaptive Damage: 15 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP and +0.1 bonus AD)
Cooldown: 20 - 8s

Damage amplification scales up to 100% at 750 range.

notes: The comet is counted as hitting. Its bonus for distance is taken to grow evenly from none at 0 range to the full bonus at 750 range; the distance is a setting, by default 750 for ranged champions and half that for melee.
The game data still holds cooldown refunds for ability hits, which the description no longer mentions; they are not counted.

controls.label: Distance to the target when the comet is hurled
Arcane Comet

runes.name: Stormraider's Surge
runes.desc:
Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health within 3s grants 48% Move Speed and 50% Slow Resistance for 4s. Move Speed is 75% effective for ranged champions.
Cooldown: 20s - 10s

notes: Stormraider's Surge only grants move speed and slow resistance; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Waterwalking
runes.desc:
Gain 10 Move Speed and 13 - 30 Adaptive Force (based on level) when in the river.

May you be as swift as the rushing river and agile as a startled Rift Scuttler.

notes: Waterwalking's Adaptive Force counts only when "You are in the river" is set.

controls.label: You are in the river

runes.name: Absolute Focus
runes.desc:
While above 70% health, gain an adaptive bonus of up to 18 Attack Damage or 30 Ability Power (based on level). 

Grants 1.8 Attack Damage or 3 Ability Power at level 1.

notes: Absolute Focus counts while "You are above 70% health" is set, which it is by default: the combo takes you to be at full health.

controls.label: You are above 70% health

runes.name: Celerity
runes.desc: All movement bonuses are 7% more effective on you and gain 1% Move Speed.

notes: Celerity only adds move speed; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.desc:
Every 10 min gain AP or AD, adaptive.

10 min: + 8 AP or 5 AD 
20 min: + 24 AP or 14 AD
30 min: + 48 AP or 29 AD
40 min: + 80 AP or 48 AD
50 min: + 120 AP or 72 AD
60 min: + 168 AP or 101 AD
etc...

notes: Minutes into the game default to a rough solo-lane pace for the level (20 minutes at level 13); set them to the game you have in mind.
As attack damage it is counted at 0.6 per ability power, as the description lists it, without its rounding.

controls.label: Minutes into the game

runes.name: Scorch
runes.desc:
Your next damaging ability hit sets champions on fire dealing 20 - 40 bonus magic damage based on level after 1s.

Cooldown: 10s

notes: Scorch is counted when it is applied, not a second later when it burns.

controls.label: Scorch

runes.name: Unflinching
runes.desc: Gain 10 Armor and Magic Resist when crowd controlled and for 2 seconds after.

notes: Unflinching's armor and magic resist only last while you are crowd controlled, so they are not counted.

runes.name: Nimbus Cloak
runes.desc:
After casting a Summoner Spell, gain a Move Speed increase that lasts for 2s and allows you to pass through units.

Increase: 15% - 45% Move Speed based on the Summoner Spell's cooldown. (Higher cooldown Summoner Spells grant more Move Speed).

notes: Nimbus Cloak only grants move speed after a summoner spell; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Last Stand
runes.desc: Deal 5% - 11% increased damage to champions while you are below 60% health. Max damage gained at 30% health.

notes: The engine takes you to be at full health, so Last Stand counts only the missing health its setting gives. Its bonus is taken to grow evenly from the start threshold down to the health where it peaks.

controls.label: Percent of your health missing during the combo

runes.name: Magical Footwear
runes.desc:
You get free Slightly Magical Footwear at 12 min, but you cannot buy boots before then. For each takedown you acquire the boots 45s sooner.

Slightly Magical Footwear grants you an additional 10 Move Speed.

notes: Magical Footwear only gives boots and move speed; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Hextech Flashtraption
runes.desc:
While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash.

Hexflash: Channel for 2s to blink to a new location.

Cooldown: 20s. Goes on a 10s cooldown when you enter champion combat.

notes: Hexflash only moves you; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Triple Tonic
runes.desc:
Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice.
Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force.
Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.

notes: The Elixir of Force (from level 6) lasts 60 seconds once drunk; its Adaptive Force counts only when "Elixir of Force is active" is set.
The Elixir of Avarice only damages minions, and the skill point of the Elixir of Skill is already in the ranks you set.

controls.label: Elixir of Force is active

runes.name: Jack Of All Trades
runes.desc:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain 8 or 20 bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks, respectively.

notes: Its stacks default to the stats your items give among those the calculator tracks; attack speed, regeneration, penetration other than lethality, heal and shield power and tenacity are not seen, so add them by hand.
The Adaptive Force is taken as 8 from 5 stacks and 20 in all from 10, not 28.

controls.label: Different stats your items give

runes.name: Cash Back
runes.desc: Get 7.5% Gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

notes: Cash Back only refunds gold; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Biscuit Delivery
runes.desc:
Biscuit Delivery: Gain a Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will every 2 mins, until 6 min.

Biscuits restore 20 + 2% of your maximum health, increased by up to 100% based on missing Health. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health by 30.

notes: The max health from eaten biscuits counts toward damage that scales with health; by default every biscuit delivered by the build's level (on a rough solo-lane pace) is eaten.
Their healing is not counted.

controls.label: Biscuits eaten

runes.name: Cosmic Insight
runes.desc:
+18 Summoner Spell Haste
+10 Item Haste

notes: Summoner spell and item haste do not change damage here: item actives are used as many times as their setting says.

runes.name: Glacial Augment
runes.desc:
Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays to emanate from them towards you and other nearby champions, creating frozen zones for 3 (+ the immobilizing effect's duration) seconds that slow enemies for 20% (+90% per 100% Heal and Shield Power) (+6% per 100 Ability Power) (+7% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) and reduce their damage by 15% against your allies (not including yourself). 

Cooldown: 25s

notes: Glacial Augment only slows and lowers the damage enemies deal to your allies; it does not change your damage.

runes.name: Time Warp Tonic
runes.desc: Consuming a potion grants 40% of its health restoration immediately.

notes: Time Warp Tonic only speeds up potion healing; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Unsealed Spellbook
runes.desc:
Swap one of your equipped Summoner Spells to a new, single use Summoner Spell. Each unique Summoner Spell you swap to permanently decreases your swap cooldown by 25s (initial swap cooldown is @f3@ seconds). 

Your first swap becomes available at 6 mins. 

Summoner Spells can only be swapped while out of combat. 
After using a swapped Summoner Spell you must swap 3 more times before the first can be selected again.
Smite damage increases after two Summoner Spell swaps.

notes: Unsealed Spellbook only swaps summoner spells, which are not part of the combo; it does not change damage.

runes.name: First Strike
runes.desc:
Attacks or abilities against an enemy champion within 0.25s of entering champion combat grant 10 gold and First Strike for 3 seconds, causing you to deal 7% extra  damage against champions, and granting 50% (35% for ranged champions) of bonus damage dealt as gold.

Cooldown: 25 - 15s

notes: First Strike is counted as set off by the combo's first hit: it amplifies all damage dealt in its first 3 seconds, that hit included. Damage over time is dealt when it is applied, so a burn that starts in time is amplified whole.
Its gold is not counted.

controls.label: The combo opens the fight (you were out of champion combat)

runes.name: Shield Bash
runes.desc:
Whenever you gain a new shield,  your next basic attack against a champion deals 5 - 30 (+2.5% Bonus Health) (+15.0% New Shield Amount) bonus adaptive damage.

You have up to 2s after the shield expires to use this effect.

notes: Shield Bash is counted on the first attack when "You gained a new shield just before the combo" is set; the combo does not know when your abilities or items shield you, so count further bashes by hand.
Its base damage is taken to grow evenly from level 1 to level 18.

controls.label: You gained a new shield just before the combo
How big that shield was
Shield Bash

runes.name: Approach Velocity
runes.desc:
Gain 7.5% Move Speed towards nearby enemy champions that are movement impaired. This bonus is increased to 15% Move Speed for any enemy champion that you impair. 

Activation Range for CC from allies: 1000

notes: Approach Velocity only adds move speed; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Conditioning
runes.desc: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.

notes: Its armor and magic resist count toward damage that scales with them once the game is past 12 minutes.
Minutes into the game default to a rough solo-lane pace for the level (20 minutes at level 13).

controls.label: Minutes into the game

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying
runes.desc:
Every 4s in combat, your next basic attack on a champion will:Deal bonus magic damage equal to 3.5% of your max healthHeal you for 1.3% of your max healthPermanently increase your health by 5
Ranged Champions: Damage, healing, and permanent health gained are 40% effective.

notes: Grasp is counted as charged for the first attack of the combo (unless that setting is off) and again 4 seconds of combat after each proc.
The max health Grasp grants during the combo is not counted; set what earlier procs gave in "Max health already gained from Grasp".

controls.label: Grasp is charged when the combo starts
Max health already gained from Grasp
Grasp of the Undying

runes.name: Aftershock
runes.desc:
After immobilizing an enemy champion, increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 45 + 75% of your Bonus Resists for 2.5s. Then explode, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

Damage: 25 - 120 (+8% of your bonus health)
Cooldown: 20s

Resistance bonus from Aftershock capped at: 80-150 (based on level)

notes: Aftershock is counted as set off by the first ability of the combo, and again after its cooldown; turn off "Your combo immobilizes the target" if it does not, or count it by hand.
The shockwave is counted when the immobilize lands, not 2.5 seconds later.
Its armor and magic resist only last 2.5 seconds, so they count for damage that scales with them only when you set them up for the whole combo.

controls.label: Your combo immobilizes the target
Aftershock's armor and magic resist are up for the whole combo
Aftershock

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.desc: After taking damage from an enemy champion, heal for 4% of your missing health over 10s.

notes: Second Wind only heals; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Demolish
runes.desc:
Your third attack against towers deals [85 (+28% max Health) Melee || 50 (+20% max Health) Ranged] bonus physical damage.

Cooldown: 30s

notes: Demolish only damages towers; it adds nothing against a champion.

runes.name: Overgrowth
runes.desc:
Absorb life essence from monsters or enemy minions that die near you, permanently gaining 3 maximum health for every 8.

When you've absorbed 120 monsters or enemy minions, gain an additional 3.5% maximum health.

notes: Its max health counts toward damage that scales with health; by default Overgrowth has absorbed the 120 units that complete it.

controls.label: Minions and monsters absorbed by Overgrowth

runes.name: Revitalize
runes.desc:
Gain 5% Heal and Shield Power.

Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% health.

notes: Revitalize only strengthens heals and shields; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Font of Life
runes.desc:
Impairing the movement of an enemy champion restores Health to you and the lowest health nearby allied champion.

70% effect for Ranged Users.

Cooldown: 20s

notes: Font of Life only heals; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Guardian
runes.desc:
Guard allies within 350 units of you, and allies you target with spells for 2.5s. While Guarding, if you or the ally take more than a small amount of damage over the duration of the Guard, both of you gain a shield for 1.5s.

Cooldown: 75 - 40 seconds
Shield: 40 - 150 + 20% of your ability power + 6% of your bonus health
Proc Threshold: 50 - 165 postmitigation damage

notes: Guardian only shields you and an ally; it does not change damage.

runes.name: Bone Plating
runes.desc:
After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from them deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage.

Duration: 1.5s
Cooldown: 55s

notes: Bone Plating only reduces the damage you take; it does not change damage dealt.

runes.name: Deathfire Touch
runes.desc:
Damaging a champion with an ability burns them for 3 - 12 based on level (+2.5% AP) (+7% bonus AD)  magic damage per second. After burning for 3 seconds, the damage of the burn increases by 75% while they remain on fire.

Duration:
Single Target: 4s
Area of Effect: 2s
Damage over Time: 1s

notes: Each ability that damages the target sets it on fire or keeps it burning: the burn runs from the first damaging ability to the last and then for its full duration, with the bonus from the third second of burning on.
Abilities count as single-target and burn for 4 seconds, or all as area abilities (2 seconds) with the setting; damage-over-time abilities, which burn for 1 second in the game, are not told apart.

controls.label: Your abilities hit an area (shorter burn)

runes.name: Absorb Life
runes.desc: Killing a target restores 1 - 23 Health based on level.

notes: Absorb Life heals on kills; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Legend: Bloodline
runes.desc:
Gain 0.45% Life Steal for every Legend stack (max 15 stacks). At maximum Legend stacks, gain 85 max health.

Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

notes: Legend: Bloodline's life steal heals and does not add damage; its bonus health at full stacks counts for abilities that scale with health.

controls.label: Legend stacks, all of them by default

runes.name: Legend: Alacrity
runes.desc:
Gain 3% attack speed plus an additional 1.5% for every Legend stack (max 10 stacks).

Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

controls.label: Legend stacks, all of them by default

runes.name: Legend: Haste
runes.desc:
Gain 1.5 basic ability haste for every Legend stack (max 10 stacks).

Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

notes: Legend: Haste only shortens the cooldowns of Q, W and E shown; it does not change the combo.

controls.label: Legend stacks, all of them by default

runes.name: Triumph
runes.desc:
Takedowns restore 5% of your missing health, 2.5% of your max health, and grant an additional 20 gold. 

'The most dangerous game brings the greatest glory.' 
—Noxian Reckoner

notes: Triumph heals and gives gold on takedowns; it deals no damage.

runes.name: Hail of Blades
runes.desc:
Gain 90% (60% for ranged champions) Attack Speed and bonus true damage when you attack an enemy champion for up to 3 attacks.

No more than 3s can elapse between attacks or this effect will end.

Cooldown: 10s.
On-Hit Damage: 2 - 20 (+0.12 bonus AD, +0.1 AP) damage.

Attack resets increase the attack limit by 1.
Allows you to temporarily exceed the Attack Speed limit.

notes: Hail of Blades empowers the first basic attacks of the fight, and again once its cooldown has run from the first of them; its damage grows evenly with level.
Its attack speed lasts while empowered attacks are left; the attack speed limit it may exceed in the game is kept.
Attack resets do not add attacks to it, and an empowered attack the champion's model writes as an ability does not use it.

controls.label: Hail of Blades
